note: Both sets extract a mix of correct text-based claims and graph data points, but both also contain numerous errors and redundancies. Both sets incorrectly claim the torque rate limit is 'not specified' despite correctly extracting it as 15,000 N·m/s elsewhere. Both sets misread the graph at 800 rpm. Set A misreads the Optimal curve at 1200 rpm, while Set B extracts nonsensical 'approx 1100' and 'approx 900' values and misattributes the rated generator speed to the filtered generator speed. They are equally flawed.
